description: This file defines the InviteController class, which manages the state of incoming invite payloads in a Flutter app. It handles parsing incoming URIs into InvitePayload objects, updating the pending invite state, and notifying listeners of changes.

classes.name: InviteController
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages incoming invite payloads, allowing the UI to react to new invites or clears.

methods.name: handleIncomingUri
methods.description: Parses an incoming deep link URI and stores it as a pending invite; notifies listeners.

methods.name: clearPendingInvite
methods.description: Clears the current pending invite and notifies listeners.
